content: Claude Agent SDK (Python/TypeScript library) embeds the same agent loop as Claude Code but for unattended/programmatic use (webhooks, CI, servers) -- not needed here since this project is explicitly an interactive, human-invoked Claude Code skill. Claude Code itself (skills + subagents + MCP) is the correct target, not the Agent SDK, because a human on the team triggers the QA run inside their normal Claude Code session.
